lines.itemName: YKK #5 open-end zipper 65 cm — assorted shades
Flat drawcord 8 mm x 130 cm, tipped

_notes: Four lines, all in pcs, all general store — nothing here is bonded, so the receipt must NOT ask for a UD. If it does, the bonded test in the store has the wrong default.
86,520 (eyelets) is the largest number on the page and is two per garment plus wastage. A reading of 8,652 or 865,200 is the digit-slip this document exists to catch.
